guide.title: Azure AD SSO Setup Guide
guide.intro: Configure Single Sign-On between Industrace and Azure AD (Microsoft 365 / Entra ID).

prerequisites.title: Prerequisites
items: Administrator access to Microsoft Azure Portal
Administrator access to Industrace
Active Microsoft 365 / Azure AD tenant

step1.title: Step 1: Register the application in Azure AD

register.title: App registration
items: Open Azure Portal and go to Microsoft Entra ID
Select App registrations → New registration
Name: Industrace SSO (or a name of your choice)
Supported account types: Accounts in this organizational directory only (recommended)
Redirect URI: Web platform with the callback URL shown below
Click Register

noteInfo.title: Save these values
items: Application (client) ID → Client ID in Industrace
Directory (tenant) ID or tenant name (e.g. contoso.onmicrosoft.com) → Tenant Domain

redirect.title: Redirect URIs
items: Open Authentication and add the callback URL shown above
Under Implicit grant, enable ID tokens (required for OIDC)
Save the configuration

permissions.title: API permissions
items: Verify Microsoft Graph delegated permissions: openid, profile, email, User.Read
To import users, add User.Read.All (Application) — requires admin consent
Click Grant admin consent for the tenant

step3.title: Step 3: Create a client secret
items: Go to Certificates & secrets → New client secret
Add a description and choose an expiry (24 months recommended)
Copy the secret Value immediately — it is shown only once
Paste it into Client Secret in Industrace

step4.title: Step 4: Configure Industrace
items: Fill in the form on this page with the Azure AD values
Click Test Connection, then Save
Enable SSO when you are ready to test login

fields.label: Tenant Domain
fields.description: Tenant ID, tenant name, or onmicrosoft.com domain

fields.label: Redirect URI
fields.description: Must match exactly the callback URL in Azure AD

fields.label: Auto-Provisioning
fields.description: Keep disabled (recommended): only existing Industrace users can sign in

fields.label: Domain Restriction
fields.description: Optional: limit sign-in to a specific email domain

step5.title: Step 5: Import users (optional)
items: Open the Import Users tab on this page
Search and select users from Azure AD
Choose a role and click Import Selected
Verify imported users under Users

step6.title: Step 6: Test SSO login
items: Log out and open the login page
Click Sign in with Microsoft
Complete authentication in Microsoft and confirm redirect back to Industrace
In Profile, verify auth_provider is azure_ad and external_id is set

issues.title: Invalid redirect URI
issues.cause: Redirect URI in Industrace does not match Azure AD.
issues.solution: Use the exact callback URL (protocol, domain, path). Remove extra spaces.

issues.title: Invalid client secret
issues.solution: Create a new client secret in Azure AD and update Industrace.

issues.title: User not found during login
issues.cause: User does not exist in Industrace and auto-provisioning is disabled.
issues.solution: Import the user manually or enable auto-provisioning (less secure).

issues.title: Domain restriction violation
issues.cause: User email domain does not match Domain Restriction.
issues.solution: Update Domain Restriction or remove it if not needed.

issues.title: SSO button missing on login page
issues.cause: SSO is disabled or configuration was not saved.
issues.solution: Enable SSO, save configuration, and check backend logs.

issues.title: Error listing/importing Azure AD users
issues.solution: Add the Application permission, grant admin consent, wait a few minutes, retry.

security.title: Security notes
items: Never share the client secret
Use HTTPS in production for redirect URIs
Keep auto-provisioning disabled unless strictly required
Rotate secrets before they expire

success.title: Login successful
success.message: You will be redirected to the dashboard...
